cross_references.note: §338(c) 3-year property damage SOL applies to Greenman strict liability claims for damage to personal property (goods/chattels). Separate from 2-year personal injury SOL under CCP §335.1.

Implied warranty breach SOL is COM §2725 (4-year). §338(a) covers statutory liability created by COM §2314 if no specific warranty SOL applies. Fraud discovered during RedJag purchase invokes §338(d).
Honeysuckle house fraud claims under CIV §1572: §338(d) fraud discovery rule is the SOL vehicle. Discovery rule tolled until audit revealed 19 unsigned documents and equity theft mechanism.

SIRVA personal injury SOL is CCP §340.5 (medical malpractice, 3 years/1 year from discovery) OR CCP §335.1 (2-year general personal injury), not §338. §338(d) fraud SOL applies only if Walgreens made misrepresentations about its administration training/procedures.
RedJag VEH §11713 dealer fraud: §338(d) discovery rule extends SOL for fraud discovered after the 2018 purchase. §338(a) applies to statutory liability under VEH §11713.
